jobs.title: Senior Engineer 2, Merchandising (Hybrid - Seattle, WA)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


As a Senior Engineer 2, you'll be part of a key team of Nordstrom Technology professionals who apply engineering and design principles to build the platform that brings Nordstrom's supplier facing experiences together. This level owns the quality of a team's work, makes sure designs are clear and complete for execution, and can take on complex design and problem solving without supervision.


You'll work across two connected areas within the Merchandising Org: Retail Hub, the platform that gives internal users and external supplier partners a single place to work across onboarded applications, and NVMS (Nordstrom Vendor Management System), which modernizes how Nordstrom manages merchandising vendor data and improves the supplier experience across JWN. Retail Hub provides shared platform capabilities, including task management, notification management, and user management, that NVMS and other onboarded apps build on top of. This is a full stack position: you'll move across frontend, backend, and integration layers, and you're expected to bring a working understanding of AI tools and technologies to how you design and build.

  

This role is offered as hybrid in Seattle, WA. Candidates must be available to work in office at the Nordstrom corporate headquarters a minimum of 4 days/week to be considered for this position.

**A day in the life...**
------------------------

* Design, build, and maintain full stack features across Retail Hub and NVMS, from React based UI to backend services and the integrations that connect them.
* Extend Retail Hub's platform level capabilities, including task management and notifications, so new and existing apps can onboard cleanly and consistently.
* Design and build event driven workflows, using events to trigger, track, and update tasks reliably as they move across services and teams.

jobs.title: Cloud Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**


LS Technologies, a Tetra Tech company, is seeking a highly skilled System Engineer to serve as the Software Development Engineer to support the design, development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of software applications and services supporting a modern cloud\-based platform for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). The engineer will work as part of a multidisciplinary cloud engineering and DevSecOps team responsible for delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available capabilities that support FAA mission and enterprise systems.

 **Job Duties \& Responsibilities \- Essential Job Functions may include, but are not limited to, the following**

* Design, develop, test, integrate, deploy, and maintain software applications and cloud\-native services supporting FAA mission systems.
* Develop scalable and maintainable applications using modern programming languages, frameworks, APIs, and software development practices.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices, backend services, and cloud\-based applications.
* Build software designed to operate within distributed and highly available cloud environments.
* Develop containerized applications using technologies such as Docker/OCI containers and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Support application deployment and lifecycle management through CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.
* Develop automated build, test, deployment, and release processes to improve software delivery and operational reliability.
* Integrate applications with cloud infrastructure, databases, messaging platforms, identity services, monitoring tools, and other enterprise services.
* Implement automated unit, integration, functional, and performance testing.
* Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and deployment issues across development, test, and production environments.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to software engineering standards, coding standards, and development best practices

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (Agent OS Platform)
jobs.description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**


ServiceTitan runs the businesses behind the trades: jobs, trucks, technicians, equipment, contracts, payments, warranties, compliance obligations, and customer history. That operational context is our advantage. We are building Agent OS to turn that context into safe, observable, production\-grade agent work.


Agent OS is the shared runtime, context, memory, action, trust, and evaluation layer behind role\-specific AI experiences across Atlas, office, field, voice, mobile, and future product surfaces. This is not a collection of chatbots. It is the platform that lets agents help contractors run their businesses with the right evidence, permissions, approvals, and audit trails.


You will help build the core engineering primitives behind that platform: agent runtime, typed tools, context and memory assembly, trust and approval flows, evaluation infrastructure, and production observability. You are not building one agent for one product surface. You are building the platform that product teams use to build many agents safely.


You will work on a small, senior AI platform team and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Data Platform, Atlas, and domain engineering teams.

**What You’ll Build**

* Agent runtime and workflow execution: Build the runtime for role\-specific agents, tool use, delegation, pause/resume, durable checkpoints, retries, and failure recovery. Agents must resume safely without losing state or duplicating side effects.
* Typed tools and action contracts: Build deterministic controls around non\-deterministic reasoning: governed reads, proposed writes, precondition checks, business invariants, scoped permissions, idempotency, audit trails, and rollback.
